group_labels.g4: Dacia pe șosea și în industrie

items.rationale: Easy board uses two >=3-way mirrors between Dacia/Roma and the generic Manualul romanizării group. All three historical groups concern the same process; the fourth group mixes Automobile Dacia, Dacia 1310, Pitești and the generic Industrie. The predicates are not four independent, strict properties. The difficult part is guessing intended bundles, not discovering a defensible trick.
items.negative_control: Do not remove all history boards or every board with a mirrored warning; this exact board has multiple interacting mirror/predicate defects.

group_labels.g4: Titluri cu metal, armă sau primejdie

items.rationale: Four novels face their four authors in a direct mirror. The last label promises Titluri cu metal, armă sau primejdie but mixes Plumb/Baltagul/Moara cu noroc/Pădurea spânzuraților (film); the label uses an unconstrained plot association for Moara cu noroc rather than a common strict title predicate. Source category is normal, with no clean difficulty progression.
items.negative_control: The novels/authors are not judged obscure; their exact factual correspondences can be suitable for Perechi. Keep those independent boards unless separately found defective.

items.rationale: Baltagul/Moromeții/Plumb/Cuvinte potrivite are directly mirrored by Mihail Sadoveanu/Marin Preda/George Bacovia/Tudor Arghezi. In the hidden-label format, this is precisely the four-way author/work correspondence disallowed by B5, with additional generic Atelierul limbii filler.
items.negative_control: Valid book-author facts do not make four-group mirrored construction high quality. Do not purge the corresponding graph links or independently valid pair boards.

items.rationale: Group Critici care mută canonul mixes three named people with generic Critic literar; group Cenacluri, reviste și orbită literară mixes specific society/review with generic Cenaclu literar. The groups also form a >=3-way mirror. Generic abstractions restate the group theme and the label conceals unlike relation types.
items.negative_control: cx_literatura_041 also has duplicate/reskin/type warnings, but a coherent editorial interpretation is possible; leave it for human playtest instead of auto-excluding all warnings.

items.rationale: The frozen source cx_geografie_028 labels a group containing Substratul dacic as Latinitate pe limbă. The surviving quick board repeats that misleading predicate although source Conexiuni is already ineligible. Substrate denotes retained indigenous-language influence, not Latin ancestry. A correct outsider/graph pairing cannot make its post-play explanation true.

installation_requirements: No automatic status demotion or deletion of approved pack/quick archive records.
Use existing owner-reserve ranking rail for exact pack IDs, after independent judgment.
Quick-game exact-ID reserve needs a bounded digest-guarded selection mechanism or separately reviewed identity-preserving wording repair; do not modify frozen payloads ad hoc.
Preserve all unrelated eligible/preferred stock and historic daily/session contracts; test excluded IDs cannot be newly selected through seeded/daily/category/starter paths or fallback.
Review source-dependent quick boards individually: a bad Conexiuni construction does not imply a bad isolated pair or trio.
Reopening any reserved board requires reviewed correction and current game-specific evidence, not a lower gate.
limits: This is a risk-prioritized editorial sample, not certification of every board.
No blanket exclusion for salience, duplicate groups, type shortcut or any warning count.
